unit_attributes.statement: For any program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter, the government must consider, on the same basis as other nongovernmental organizations, religious organizations to provide the assistance under the program, so long as the program is implemented in a manner consistent with the Establishment Clause of the first amendment to the Constitution.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For any program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter, so long as the program is implemented in a manner consistent with the Establishment Clause of the first amendment to the Constitution

unit_attributes.statement: Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government receiving funds under this chapter shall discriminate against an organization that provides assistance under, or applies to provide assistance under, this chapter, on the basis that the organization has a religious character.

unit_attributes.actor_quote: Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government receiving funds under this chapter
unit_attributes.modality_quote: Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government receiving funds under this chapter shall discriminate

unit_attributes.statement: A religious organization that provides assistance under a program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter, shall retain its religious character and control over the definition, development, practice, and expression of its religious beliefs.
unit_attributes.actor: A religious organization that provides assistance under a program described in subsection (a)
unit_attributes.actor_quote: A religious organization that provides assistance under a program described in subsection (a)

unit_attributes.statement: Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government shall require a religious organization to alter its form of internal governance, except (for purposes of administration of the community services block grant program) as provided in section 9910 of this title, or to remove religious art, icons, scripture, or other symbols, in order to be eligible to provide assistance under a program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter.
unit_attributes.actor: Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government
unit_attributes.actor_quote: Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government
unit_attributes.scope_text: in order to be eligible to provide assistance under a program described in subsection (a)
unit_attributes.modality_quote: Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government shall require

unit_attributes.statement: A religious organization’s exemption provided under section 2000e–1 of this title regarding employment practices shall not be affected by its participation in, or receipt of funds from, programs carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter.

No funds provided directly to a religious organization to provide assistance under any program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter, shall be expended for sectarian worship, instruction, or proselytization.
unit_attributes.modality_quote: No funds provided directly to a religious organization to provide assistance under any program described in subsection (a) shall be expended

unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (2) of subsection (d), any religious organization providing assistance under any program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter, shall be subject to the same regulations as other nongovernmental organizations to account in accord with generally accepted accounting principles for the use of such funds provided under such program.
unit_attributes.actor: any religious organization providing assistance under any program described in subsection (a)
unit_attributes.actor_quote: any religious organization providing assistance under any program described in subsection (a)

unit_attributes.statement: A religious organization providing assistance under a program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter, shall segregate government funds provided under such program into a separate account.

Where a religious organization segregates government funds provided under a program described in subsection (a) into a separate account, only the government funds shall be subject to audit by the government.
An intermediate organization refers to an eligible entity or other organization acting under a contract, or grant or other agreement, with the Federal Government or a State or local government.

If an eligible entity or other organization (referred to in this subsection as an “intermediate organization”), acting under a contract, or grant or other agreement, with the Federal Government or a State or local government, is given the authority under the contract or agreement to select nongovernmental organizations to provide assistance under the programs described in subsection (a), the intermediate organization shall have the same duties under section 9920 of this title as the government.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If an eligible entity or other organization (referred to in this subsection as an “intermediate organization”), acting under a contract, or grant or other agreement, with the Federal Government or a State or local government, is given the authority under the contract or agreement to select nongovernmental organizations to provide assistance under the programs described in subsection (a)
